highlights: • Ask MIRA AI assistant live for Super Admin: ask about attendance, leave, tasks, tickets, payroll and more
• Field visit staff can no longer get stuck: away-from-site / no-GPS clocks go to Super Admin approval
• Employee profile now has 16 tabs: Attendance, Leaves, Leaves Quota, Projects, Tasks, Timesheet, Tickets, Appreciation, Shift Roster, Activity
• Activity timeline: attendance, leave, tasks, tickets, approvals, assets, expenses and more in one place
• Leaves Quota redesigned like the old tool: date range, KPIs, per-type table, leave dates
• Managers can view their team's attendance, leave, quota, tasks and roster
• Directory: newest joiners first; header search shows email and photo

modules.works: Role-based workspace, KPI cards, probation action card, Excel export, real data on the new (v2) dashboard.
Directory (search, filters, active/deactivated), 360° profiles, org chart, documents, login email change, HR login hand over.
Invite with temporary password, joiner fills own profile, required checklist, HR review with per-note checkboxes, document rules and waivers.
modules.gaps: Super Admin review steps to be tested end to end; e-signature not built.

modules.works: Jobs, candidate pipeline, interviews (IST), offers with payroll annexure and tax regime, public careers page with clean links.
Clock in/out with office geofence and approvals, field-visit photo approval, WFC from anywhere, no clock-in on off days, shift change, Team Timeline override.
modules.gaps: Multi-day override, 20th/27th attendance reminder, double LOP rule not built.

modules.works: Leave requests and approvals, probation rules (no paid leave, pro-rata on confirmation), comp-off balance from approved requests, permanent WFH.
Roster, bulk permanent shift change (Super Admin), Change Shift pop-up, days off follow the shift.
Requests, approvals, reschedule/postpone, NCR per-km allowance by grade, live route sharing with Finance, outside-site photo approval.
modules.gaps: Photo step reaches staff only with mobile app 2.5.3.

modules.works: Review cycles, KPIs, probation tab, manager review before HR confirms, letters, PIP & notice.
Configurable rules engine, pay profiles (AI document check), salary groups, PF/ESI/PT/TDS, consultants with GST, LOP basis, payslips, dry run.

bugs.bug: Out-of-office clock-in raised no approval (Sudeep Jain)
bugs.cause: VIP Shift had the office location check turned off.
bugs.fix: Turned the check on for VIP Shift; today's clock-in sent for Super Admin approval.
bugs.steps:
1. Settings → Master Data → Shifts → open 'VIP Shift' → 'Office geofence' is ON.
2. Approvals (sidebar) or Attendance & Leave → Clock-out Approvals → out-of-office list.
3. Sudeep Jain, 16 Nov is there (42 km away) waiting for Super Admin.
4. Optional: a VIP Shift user clocks in away from office → reason box appears.

bugs.bug: Approval email showed 'Temporary Password: nexerp2026'
bugs.cause: Old email template with a fixed password; joiners set their own.
bugs.fix: New welcome email with no password.
bugs.steps:
1. Employees → Onboarding → Profile reviews.
2. Open a submitted joiner → Approve.
3. Joiner's inbox: subject 'Your MIRA profile is approved — welcome aboard'.
4. The email must NOT show any password.

2. Type 'Akshara Shukla' in Search employees.
3. Her row appears (greyed, Deactivated).
4. Also try 'Shukla Akshara' and 'akshara 20188'.

bugs.cause: Filter defaulted to Active while showing 'All employees'.
bugs.fix: Default is all employees; deactivated greyed at the bottom.

1. Employees → Employee Directory (filters cleared).
2. Scroll to the bottom: deactivated people show greyed out.
3. 'All employees' filter shows everyone by default.

bugs.bug: Active / Deactivated filter did nothing
bugs.cause: Table was not refreshed after the filter changed.
bugs.fix: Filter refreshes the table.
bugs.steps:
1. Employees → Employee Directory.
2. Status filter ('All employees') → choose Deactivated → only deactivated rows show.
3. Choose Active → they disappear.
4. Clear all → everyone shows again.

decisions.decision: Every payroll rule is configurable by Finance
Comp-off only for approved field visits; roster decides the day off
Optional holiday = office open; working it earns 1 comp-off day automatically; other holidays closed (except approved field visits)
Hourly cost visible to Super Admin only; personal rate overrides grade; changes apply from effective date
Missed clock-out without a reason counts as Pending (no Auto-closed state)
Leave Applications opens on Pending; Emergency = applied on the day the leave starts
